items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the tax assessment
items.quote: Die Einspruchsfrist beträgt einen Monat und rechnet ab der Bekanntgabe; ein Bescheid, der als Brief verschickt wird, ist am vierten Tag nach dem Absenden als bekannt gegeben anzusehen.
items.computation: Letter dated Thu 19.11.2026, sent by ordinary post by a German tax authority — it counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting (§ 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO), i.e. Mon 23.11.2026 (4th day not shifted because it's not a weekend/holiday). The one-month Einspruchsfrist (§ 355 AO) starts the day after deemed delivery (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB / § 108 Abs. 1 AO), so it runs from 24.11.2026, and ends one month later on the day numerically corresponding to the delivery day (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB) = Wed 23.12.2026. That day is a working day in Bremen (not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday), so no shift applies under § 108 Abs. 3 AO.

items.computation: The letter states the tax office will transfer the credit but gives no specific payment date; no due date can be determined from the text, this is informational only (money owed TO the recipient, not an obligation with a deadline for them).

warnings: The refund IBAN (DE14 5139 0000 0074 4022 18) printed in the letter is the recipient's own account as stated by the Finanzamt; a well-formed IBAN only confirms its format, not ownership — verify it matches your own bank details before assuming the refund is correctly addressed.

The letter mentions a personal tax detail (Berufsunfähigkeitsversicherung contributions not deductible) that is specific to the taxpayer's situation — check this against your own records if you believe it is incorrect, as it affects whether an Einspruch is worthwhile.
